headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — TELANGANA
title: IMD Hyderabad forecast very heavy monsoon rains on Sunday 13 Sep; orange alert i
key_facts: IMD Hyderabad forecast very heavy monsoon rains on Sunday 13 Sep; orange alert issued
heavy rainfall very likely in isolated areas of Adilabad, Kumuram Bheem Asifabad, Mancherial, Peddapalli
thunderstorms/lightning/gusty winds at isolated places in many districts incl. Hyderabad; city: light to moderate rain or thundershowers, cloudy
season rainfall 519.1 mm vs normal 649.9 mm (-20%)
bullets_en: IMD Hyderabad has forecast very heavy monsoon rains on Sunday and issued an orange alert for Telangana.
Heavy rainfall is very likely in isolated areas of Adilabad, Kumuram Bheem Asifabad, Mancherial and Peddapalli districts.
Thunderstorms with lightning and gusty winds are likely at isolated places in many districts, including Hyderabad.
Hyderabad city is likely to see light to moderate rain or thundershowers under a generally cloudy sky.
Telangana has received 519.1 mm rain this monsoon so far, about 20 per cent below normal.
bullets_ur: IMD Hyderabad ne Sunday ko nihayat tez monsoon barishon ki peshgoi ki hai aur Telangana ke liye orange alert jaari kiya hai.
Adilabad, Kumuram Bheem Asifabad, Mancherial aur Peddapalli districts ke alag alag ilaqon mein tez barish ka strong imkaan hai.
Hyderabad samait bohat se districts mein garaj, bijli aur tez hawaon ke sath toofan ka imkaan hai.
Hyderabad shehar mein halki se darmiyani barish ya thundershowers ka imkaan hai aur aasman par badal chhaye rahenge.
Is monsoon mein ab tak Telangana ko 519.1 mm barish mili hai, jo aam se taqreeban 20 per cent kam hai.

headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS — HYDERABAD
title: Woman From Andhra Pradesh Dies After Falling Under RTC Bus in Ameerpet
key_facts: 26-year-old woman Hemadurga, Bhimavaram (AP) native, worked at a car company in Banjara Hills
Saturday 12 Sep: stepped out during office break, booked Rapido reportedly to get cellphone repaired
RTC (electric) bus hit the bike taxi in Ameerpet; woman riding pillion came under wheels, died
bullets_en: A 26-year-old woman from Andhra Pradesh was killed in Ameerpet on Saturday when an RTC bus hit the Rapido bike taxi she was travelling on.
The victim, Hemadurga, was a Bhimavaram native who worked at a car company in Banjara Hills.
She had stepped out during an office break and reportedly booked the bike taxi to get her cellphone repaired.
The woman, riding pillion, came under the bus wheels, while the rider was seriously injured and hospitalised.
bullets_ur: Andhra Pradesh se taluq rakhne wali 26-sala khatoon Saturday ko Ameerpet mein us waqt halak ho gayi jab unke sawar Rapido bike taxi ko ek RTC bus ne takkar maar di.
Halak hone wali khatoon Hemadurga Bhimavaram ki rehne wali thin aur Banjara Hills mein ek car company mein kaam karti thin.
Wo office break ke doran bahar niklin aur reportedly apna cellphone theek karwane ke liye bike taxi book ki thi.
Khatoon pillion par sawar thin aur bus ke pahiye tale aa gayin, jabke rider shadeed zakhmi halat mein hospital mein zair-e-ilaj hai.
